selection: Sort Composite Trend IDs within published score=0, 0<score<1, score=1 strata; first four from each. Freeze before reading raw series. Case-control sample, not population estimator.
arms: exact released skill template with SAX
full-year raw with same metric and recomputed quantile
full-year raw with original candidate quantile frozen
original candidates with corrected monotone endpoint
full-year raw with corrected monotone endpoint
independent_algorithm: Fit exactly the requested number of ordered segments by dynamic programming over all contiguous nonoverlapping partitions; at least 4 points/segment; OLS SSE objective, positive slopes for rise, negative slopes for fall, unconstrained stable. Target index parsed from exact requested phrase (unique match required); target absolute slope for rise/fall, raw segment standard deviation for stable. No floor. No adjective magnitude thresholds. All days ranked; this is a diagnostic heuristic, not a benchmark oracle or a perfect pattern verifier.
causal_limits: Only our CPU executions have SQL traces. Published prediction cannot establish original candidates or code. Full-year interventions change access and may change floor; frozen-floor arm separates these. All thresholds fixed before raw inspection; no label-derived candidates.
expansion: Only after Composite Trend initial results; preserve all cases regardless of outcomes. No automatic expansion to full benchmark.
